paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 36:6, where R' Tanchuma reports in his name.[^1]

notes.text: Both personal titles are abbreviated and retained as R'. Tanchuma reports in the contextual heading subject Chiyya’s name. 36:6 is the conventional chapter/section reading, without a separately verified named edition or identity binding.
